d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and a delicate black vine-like crown adorns a youthful face with narrow, sharp purple eyes. The slender build is dressed in a short black halter-neck dress with a purple gradient hem and a gold chain accent, layered under a voluminous, floor-length deep purple robe with wide sleeves. A thin silver chain wraps around one thigh, and the character holds a black rectangular card with pink holographic text.
